data.gender_notes: Filiberto is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Filiberto is derived from the Latin word 'filius' meaning 'son' and 'berto' meaning 'bright, shining, strong'. This name was commonly given to sons born into noble families. It was also a popular name among the early Christians, symbolizing the brightness and strength of faith. The name Filiberto carries the meaning “Bright, Shining, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Filiberto usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
